extraction_notes: P-channel electrical values are stored as positive magnitudes while conditions preserve the datasheet negative polarity and the polarity field is p.
The transfer, output, capacitance, gate-charge, and source-drain diode figures are typical plotted curves. Curve points are manual reads from actual plotted traces, not interpolated table values.
The transfer figure contains -55 °C, 25 °C, and 125 °C curves; only the 25 °C curve is included for fitting conditions.
The output figure contains VGS = -3 V, -4 V, and -5 V through -10 V curves; the -3 V and -4 V traces are included because their plotted saturation regions are readable.
The capacitance table gives typical Ciss = 565 pF, Coss = 126 pF, and Crss = 75 pF at VGS = 0 V, VDS = -15 V, f = 1 MHz. The capacitance plot is digitized separately.
No typical VGS(th) value is tabulated; only -1 V MIN and -3 V MAX are published at ID = -250 µA and VDS = VGS.
RDS(on) values are published maximums only: 50 mΩ at VGS = -10 V, ID = -3 A, and 70 mΩ at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -2.5 A.
The datasheet publishes VSD as a maximum at IS = -1.25 A but publishes no trr value. It publishes RthJA = 100 °C/W and no RthJC value.
Gate-charge table values are Qg = 10 nC TYP and 15 nC MAX at VDS = -15 V, with Qgs = 1.9 nC and Qgd = 2 nC; the plotted gate-charge curve is a typical figure at ID = -3 A.
